tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided subcritical siphon base and signed square-root branch numerically. Its three coefficients are linear combinations of vmax, rho, and the local branch coefficient, allowing the five pilot observations to identify them before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot rows span the drive and gradient and identify the three coefficients of the guided square-root branch; a probe is not needed for identifiability.
Pilot gradients are at or below 2.2, below the stated gray-zone threshold of 2.36.
The matched siphon subtree and gradient-dependent pilot signature support the guided model instead.
